receipts.context: (()=>{const events=window.__startupProbe;if(!events?.length)throw Error('No startup probe');const recovery=events.findIndex(e=>e.kind==='getItem'&&e.key==='xray.recovery-journal/v1');const firstWrite=events.findIndex(e=>e.kind==='setItem'&&e.key==='xray:fencing-job:v2');if(recovery<0||(firstWrite>=0&&firstWrite<recovery))throw Error('Project write preceded recovery playback read');return {readyState:document.readyState,hydration:document.querySelector('[data-hydration-status]')?.dataset.hydrationStatus,events,modules:performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e=>/\.(tsx?|jsx?)(\?|$)/.test(e.name)).length}})()
